confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates use sparse Arica price data published around October 2026 as a proxy for July 2026. Cocktail and wine prices are less certain; the wine glass estimate uses its local price relationship to beer. Accommodation values are holistic estimates, not live listing prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Arica city-level price estimates; accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of a northern Chilean coastal city, broadly comparable to Iquique.
